implementation: The existing public CPU ProgramBuilder API aliases a scoped builder whose borrowed backend and fixed cache cannot enter immutable programs or worker packets
Known base-field addition, multiplication and inversion and cubic-extension multiplication and inversion use the selected GPU backend in all registered recursive compiler variants

The fixed 64-entry device-only cache compares complete canonical operand keys and safely replaces collisions; successful zero-inverse results are cached while runtime inverse instructions and interning order are preserved
Each GPU fold uses six input words and four output words, 80 managed bytes total; the cache is bounded to 8192 host bytes within the existing public-hash reservation
The first backend failure is latched; later folds perform no arithmetic or cache lookups, finish refuses to return a partial program, and shared compiler finish preserves the original backend cause
Only completed kernels report Preprocessing event time; cache hits add no kernel calls and a later compiler failure retains prior completed observations
limitations: Integration proofs are bounded recursive empty proofs at height 2048, not full-size wrapped-wallet, merged, finalized or mixed-transaction root proofs
Root conformance covers all transaction kinds, ordered dense prefixes, padding, context binding, metadata rejection and finalizer derivation; this is not a full transaction-throughput measurement
ProgramBuilder folding uses the selected backend; symbolic AIR construction and remaining setup arithmetic still need an audit/backend, so complete GPU compiler arithmetic is not claimed
Full wallet/pair program qualification remains open; bounded periodic-verifier checks and real wallet AIR interpolation checks do not qualify complete wrapped-wallet proving
Individual remaining stage observations and strict GPU admission are unfinished
Wallet/batch and C-ABI proving arithmetic, unsupported legacy/profile arithmetic, AMD/Metal qualification, full-size memory, cancellation/retry and sustained pool throughput remain open
